profile.headline: ML Programmer at Google with a sideline in Biotechnology Startups

positions.title: Algorithmic Ethicist (Protocol Engineering)
positions.description:
Worked on the bleeding edge of protocol designs to use them to design utopias and dystopias, then folded the results back into the protocol. Incentive compatible mechanism design. Zero knowledge proofs. Low trust probabilistic micropayments. Non-altruistic punishment systems. Benevolent and malevolent monetary policy. Smart contracts. CAP theorem. FLP theorem. Byzantine Fault Tolerant Consensus. Etc.

Chief personal output: near total success on third party facing ethical impacts. Orchid did not cause a single collapse of a single benevolent government nor any genocides, and probably won't be causally central to any such events in the future.

publications.title: Viral and microbial community dynamics in four aquatic environments.
